title: Verification packet source row
purpose: Represent a grounded-search, model-review, and expert-review packet as a governed source without exposing raw private reviewer material.
privacy_rule: Do not export reviewer names, emails, raw message bodies, signatures, quoted threads, or raw search payloads by default.

title: Verified or held versioned fact row
purpose: Store the claim or fact dependency being verified, including jurisdiction, source URL, effective date, and review state.
privacy_rule: Keep claim text and public source metadata; private user context remains tenant-bound.

title: Verification promotion decision row
purpose: Store whether a knowledge object can promote, must hold, or needs additional evidence before deployment into dependent pipelines.
privacy_rule: Decision rationale may reference conflicts and channels but should not include raw reviewer correspondence.

title: Grounded/model/expert evidence row
purpose: Store each evidence channel as a separate searchable row so later replies or source checks can be appended incrementally.
privacy_rule: Expert evidence stores role, assessment, hashes, and structured rationale; raw contact data remains private.

title: High-risk verification review ticket
purpose: Route critical, conflicted, stale, or held verification packets into human review before publication or pipeline redeployment.
privacy_rule: Ticket reasons should be operational and avoid personal reviewer details.

title: Verification packet search record
purpose: Emit keyword, vector, graph, facet, quality, and freshness index rows for verified facts, decision gates, and evidence rows.
privacy_rule: Search text should use structured evidence and public-safe labels only.
